width = 70  # Total width of the profile

# Calculate the dimensions for the blocks

web_y_size = height

# Block 2: Flange (top horizontal part)

flange_top_y_size = web_thickness
flange_top_z_size = length

# Block 3: Flange (bottom horizontal part)
flange_bottom_x_size = width
flange_bottom_y_size = web_thickness
flange_bottom_z_size = length

# Positions for the blocks
# Web is centered in the x-direction
web_x = (width - web_thickness) / 2
web_y = 0
web_z = 0

# Flange top is placed at the top of the web
flange_top_x = 0
flange_top_y = height - web_thickness
flange_top_z = 0

# Flange bottom is placed at the bottom of the web
flange_bottom_x = 0
flange_bottom_y = 0
flange_bottom_z = 0

# Return the calculated values
{
    "x_sizes": x_sizes,
